environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native) deployed within VPC subnet subnet-0x9f8e7d (10.0.128.0/24). Subnet route table rtb-priv07 contains only local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for internet-facing services, and no transit gateway attachment. ENI security group sg-0deadbeef allows inbound from internal ALB only (sg-0cafebabe) on port 8080, egress rules limited to 10.0.0.0/16 on port 5432 (PostgreSQL internal). Lambda invoked exclusively via internal ALB target group (not function URL). ALB listener restricted to VPC CIDR source via security group sg-0cafebabe ingress from 10.0.0.0/16 only. No VPC peering connections. No PrivateLink endpoints except com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs for CloudWatch.

config.security_group_lambda: sg-0deadbeef: ingress tcp/8080 from sg-0cafebabe only, egress tcp/5432 to 10.0.0.0/16 only
config.internet_gateway: not attached to this subnet's route table
